messages.S1で自分の振動回数を貯め、S2・S3を複数攻撃化して振動を撒き、振動爆発させる: A Blunt attacker that builds her own Tremor Count with S1, then turns S2 and S3 into attacks that hit multiple targets to spread and burst Tremor. S2's debuffs and the combat passive's Defense Level Down also support the whole Tremor team's damage.
messages.S1「締め付ける拘束具」(起点): 使用時とⅠコイン的中時に、自分の振動回数が3: **S1 — Contracting Straight-jacket (starter)**: On use and on Coin Ⅰ hit, increases her Tremor Count by 3 each, and also by 3 on Clash Lose. On hit, it also increases the enemy's Tremor Count by 2/3.
messages.S2「金属の響き」(主力): 戦闘開始時に自分の振動回数を5消耗して攻撃加重値+: **S2 — Metallic Ringing (main skill)**: At Combat Start, spends 5 of her Tremor Count for +1 Attack Weight. She recovers +4 Tremor Count on use and +1 on Coin Ⅰ Heads Hit. Inflicts 1 Offense Level Down and 1 Plus Coin Drop next turn, and Coin Ⅲ inflicts 4/5 Tremor.
messages.S3「解かれた暴力性」: 戦闘開始時に振動回数を5消耗するごとに攻撃加重値+1(: **S3 — Unleashed Violence**: At Combat Start, gains +1 Attack Weight for every 5 Tremor Count spent, up to +2. Every Coin triggers Tremor Burst and adds 20/30% of the Stagger Threshold shift as Wrath damage, up to 13/20. Deals more damage for each negative effect on the target. Losing the Clash costs her 20 SP.
messages.バトルパッシブ「押し流された後悔」(憤怒×6・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 自分の生: **Combat passive — Coerced Regret (6 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: While she is alive, enemies hit by Tremor Burst gain 2 Defense Level Down, up to 1/3 times per enemy per turn. Allies' Tremor Bursts also trigger it. In Clashes against opponents with at least 3 negative effects, it lowers the opponent's Clash Power.
messages.守備「積もらせるわだかまり」: 使用時に自分の振動回数+3/6。S1が手札にない: **Defense skill — Gathering Spite**: On use, +3/6 to her Tremor Count. It substitutes for S1 when S1 is not in hand.
messages.1ターン目はS1(または守備)で振動回数を貯め、次のターンにS2を広域で撃つ。S: On the first turn, build Tremor Count with S1 or her Defense skill, then fire S2 as a multi-target attack the next turn. S2 recovers at most 5 — 4 on use and 1 on Coin Ⅰ Heads Hit, which requires Heads — so at best it exactly offsets the 5 it spends. Tremor Count drops by 1 after each turn, so using only S2 from a single slot loses Count every turn, and from the second use on she falls short of the multi-target condition. Alternate S1 and S2, or top up her Count in the same turn with S1 or her Defense skill. S2's Plus Coin Drop and Offense Level Down are useful even against a single boss. Use S3 as a multi-target attack when she has Tremor Count to spare to trigger Tremor Burst 3 times. S2 and S3 spend their Count at Combat Start, so in wave battles the skill can fizzle if the enemies are wiped out, losing the Count for nothing.
